title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Nicklaus on Ball Rollback
items.text: Jack Nicklaus said the golf-ball rollback will likely pull Rory McIlroy back 12 to 14 yards, which might benefit Rory by keeping him out of trouble, and calls delaying the rule to 2030 like throwing a deck chair off the Titanic.

items.headline: Brad Dalke’s PGA Entry
items.text: YouTuber Brad Dalke accepted a sponsor exemption to play in the 2026 Rocket Classic, marking his first PGA Tour event in 10 years.
